options.name: automount
options.description: Allow the module to temporarily mount the targeted btrfs filesystem in order to validate the current state and make any required changes.

options.name: default
options.description: Make the subvolume specified by O(name) the filesystem's default subvolume.

options.name: filesystem_device
options.description: A block device contained within the btrfs filesystem to be targeted. Useful when multiple btrfs filesystems are present to specify which filesystem should be targeted.

options.name: filesystem_label
options.description: A descriptive label assigned to the btrfs filesystem to be targeted. Useful when multiple btrfs filesystems are present to specify which filesystem should be targeted.

options.name: filesystem_uuid
options.description: A unique identifier assigned to the btrfs filesystem to be targeted. Useful when multiple btrfs filesystems are present to specify which filesystem should be targeted.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the subvolume/snapshot to be targeted.

options.name: recursive
options.description: When true, indicates that parent/child subvolumes should be created/removedas necessary to complete the operation (for O(state=present) and O(state=absent) respectively).

options.name: snapshot_conflict
options.description: Policy defining behavior when a subvolume already exists at the path of the requested snapshot. V(skip) - Create a snapshot only if a subvolume does not yet exist at the target location, otherwise indicate that no change is required. Warning, this option does not yet verify that the target subvolume was generated from a snapshot of the requested source. V(clobber) - If a subvolume already exists at the requested location, delete it first. This option is not idempotent and results in a new snapsh

options.name: snapshot_source
options.description: Identifies the source subvolume for the created snapshot. Infers that the created subvolume is a snapshot.

options.name: state
options.description: Indicates the current state of the targeted subvolume.
